thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Given a $165.00 Price Target at Rosenblatt Securities

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple (AAPL) Given a $165.00 Price Target at Rosenblatt Securities
text: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has been given a $165.00 target price by research analysts at Rosenblatt Securities in a research note issued to investors on Thursday, Marketbeat Ratings reports. The brokerage currently has a “neutral” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Rosenblatt Securities’ target price would suggest a potential downside of 3.96% from the company’s research analysts also recently commented on the company. HSBC set a $200.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” note on Tuesday. JPMorgan Chase & Co. set a $266.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” note on Friday, November 30th. Canaccord Genuity dropped their price target on Apple from $250.00 to $225.00 and set a “buy” rating for the company in a report on Thursday, November 29th. Wedbush raised Apple to an “outperform” rating and dropped their price target for the stock from $310.00 to $275.00 in a report on Wednesday, November 28th. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Finally, BidaskClub cut Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a report on Wednesday, November 28th. Four research analysts sell rating, twenty-three have given a hold rating and twenty-four have issued a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock presently has an average rating of “Hold” $219.67.
